visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a hotel room featuring two twin beds with white linens and blue decorative runners; the headboards are light wood against a blue and white patterned accent wall. Natural light fills the space through a large window. (2) A transition shows a stunning golden sunrise over a calm ocean, viewed through a window frame with low-rise buildings in the foreground. (3) The camera pans through a spacious hotel suite showing a grey sofa, a wooden desk with a circular mirror on a teal wall, and a wooden dining set with four chairs. The lighting is warm and bright from indoor fixtures. (4) Close-ups reveal a small kitchenette with an induction stove and a red pot, followed by a bathroom with a white porcelain bathtub against wood-textured walls. (5) On a bright outdoor beach, white sand meets turquoise water under a clear blue sky. A hand enters the frame holding a piece of white coral. (6) A sea turtle is seen swimming in clear shallow water, followed by a boat ride toward rocky formations. (7) Inside a glass-bottom boat, the camera looks through green-tinted panels at the seafloor, capturing fish, coral, a sea turtle, and a sea snake. (8) The final sequence shows a yellow 'HATENOHAMA' flag fluttering on the beach and footprints in the sand leading to the water, ending with a social media contact screen.
